title: Single-axis ablations
label: tab:exp40-ablations
caption: Single-axis ablation results.
description: This table compares the Full configuration with five single-axis ablations across coordinate alignment, local attribute quality, statement error, inertia, and joint AOPC response. Its purpose is to show which registered components affect predictive and mechanism-facing behavior while retaining unfavorable or non-uniform outcomes.
context_notes: Values are reported mean ± sample standard deviation over seeds 17, 29, and 43.
Numerical best/second-best markers are omitted because the ablations do not provide uniform causal support.
All unfavorable ablation outcomes are retained.
